title: Fix coherence issues
description:
Fix the following cross-task coherence issues. Each recommendation is from the coherence checker's analysis of all completed task diffs against the spec.

1. Change var(--color-green) to var(--color-emerald) in LearnPanel.tsx:52 and LearnPanel.test.tsx:75.
2. Add a '/' entry to sidebar.tsx navItems with a Home icon and 'Home' or 'Landing' label.
3. Add a '/' entry to header.tsx views map with title 'Landing' and a description.
4. Fix PendingReview.completedAt in landing.ts:28 to 'string | null' and add a null guard in JudgePanel.tsx:116 before calling formatDate().
5. Either remove the greeting field from the backend LandingView type (since the frontend computes it client-side) or have TopBar accept and use the backend greeting as a fallback.

Follow spec schemas exactly for field names, types, and structure. Do not refactor beyond what the recommendations ask for.
acceptance_criteria:
- Each coherence recommendation is addressed or has a comment explaining why it was skipped
- speed coherence passes after these fixes
- No new lint/typecheck/test failures
- All quality gates pass
decisions: sidebar.tsx already had '/' entry with House icon from task 20 merge — no change needed
header.tsx '/' entry existed with title 'Overview' (task 20 decision); changed to 'Landing' per coherence recommendation

For issue 5 (greeting coherence), chose the TopBar fallback approach: added optional greeting? prop so the backend value can be used if passed, without breaking the existing call site in page.tsx that doesn't pass it
JudgePanel.tsx is owned by task 12 but required the null guard fix here since it directly uses PendingReview.completedAt whose type change I made in landing.ts
concerns: JudgePanel.tsx is flagged as undeclared (task 12 owns it) — the null guard is a required cascading fix from the completedAt type change, not a feature addition
page.tsx (task 17) does not currently pass greeting to TopBar based on the test mock — the optional prop will have no effect until page.tsx is updated to forward it
